_comment_guardrail_G1: Each per-cert decision is independently recorded in that child's audit_log (G1 preserved per child). A cert not explicitly toggled APPROVED defaults to PENDING — never auto-approved. The server validates every individual decision before recording.
_comment_callback: Callback body: { batch_id, decisions: [{workflow_id, decision, reasoning}], approver: user.email }. The server reconstructs per-cert decisions from the toggle values plus any APPROVE_ALL/REJECT_ALL override. Per-cert reasoning is stored on the child workflow_state.approval record.
_comment_accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA: anomalous rows are identified by text label '[ANOMALY]' not color alone; toggle label includes the CN for AT discoverability; all actions have tooltip text; reasoning field has a text label.
_comment_pagination: If total > 15, the card is split across pages using Copilot Studio / Power Automate pagination. Each page is a separate card in a card carousel; the callback accumulates decisions across pages before recording.
_comment_fallback: The same batch decision set is available via a Power Automate Approval with per-item response, writing the same Cosmos records. The Power Automate flow is triggered when Teams card delivery fails.
